lines.text: A flaky dependency throws 503 — service unavailable. To an agent, that's just a string. No category. No plan. Text.
The runtime classifies it: category — dependency. Strategy — fallback, or retry. Three tries. Backoff at five, fifteen, sixty seconds.
The agent doesn't panic, and doesn't hammer. It retries on schedule.
Same call, next window — the answer comes back, and the run continues. Uninterrupted.
Six categories. Six recovery plans. No string-parsing, ever again.
Errors machines can use. var-runtime. Proof-or-Stop.

bgm.query: dark-tech minimal ambient, slow build, one impact at the success retry (~30s)
